requirements.verifier_assertion: `python -m hatch dep add --help` exits 0 and its combined output contains 'Usage:' and 'dep add' (test_dep_add_has_help).
`python -m hatch dep remove --help` exits 0 and its combined output contains 'Usage:' and 'dep remove' (test_dep_remove_has_help).

`python -m hatch dep --help` exits 0 and its combined output has an `add` row and a `remove` row (regex `^\s*add\b` / `^\s*remove\b`) — the two subcommands must be registered under the `hatch dep` group (test_dep_add_appears_in_dep_help).

`hatch dep add requests>=2` against a multi-line `dependencies` array appends `"requests>=2",` as a new line (indentation preserved), emits ``Added `requests>=2` to field `project.dependencies` ``, and preserves the rest byte-for-byte (test_append_preserves_formatting).
Inline comments (e.g. `# CLI framework` next to `"click>=8",`), comment-only lines, and blank lines are all preserved byte-for-byte across an add operation (test_comments_preserved).
must_include: comments, blank lines, and indentation untouched

requirements.verifier_assertion: When `[project]` exists but `dependencies` does not, `hatch dep add requests>=2` writes `dependencies = ["requests>=2"]` as an inline array at the end of `[project]` (test_create_dependencies_field).
must_include: newly created field is written as an inline array
inserted at the end of the table it belongs to

requirements.verifier_assertion: An existing inline `dependencies = ["click>=8"]` array, on add, stays inline: `dependencies = ["click>=8", "requests>=2"]` with the `, ` separator (test_inline_array_stays_inline).
Adding `'requests>=2; python_version >= "3.9"'` writes the entry with single-quoted marker literal: `requests>=2; python_version >= '3.9'` (test_marker_quoting_normalized).
must_include: marker quoting is normalized to single quotes

requirements.verifier_assertion: Adding `click>=9` when `Click>=8` already exists (same normalized name) exits non-zero, the error mentions `click` and contains the literal text `--force`, and pyproject.toml is unchanged (test_conflict_requires_force_and_writes_nothing).
must_include: the error message has to contain the literal text `--force`

requirements.verifier_assertion: With `--force`, the old entry is replaced at its original position; surrounding entries are neither reordered nor duplicated (test_force_replaces_in_place).
must_include: replaced in place at its original position
no appending, no reordering of the remaining entries

requirements.verifier_assertion: Repeat `hatch dep add requests>=2 --force` on an already-present-identical entry exits 0 and leaves pyproject.toml byte-identical to after the first add (test_force_idempotent_byte_for_byte).
must_include: no appending, no reordering of the remaining entries

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep add requests>=2 "not a requirement !!!"` exits non-zero, error mentions the bad input (`not a requirement !!!` or `Invalid`), and pyproject.toml is unchanged — the good arg is not partially applied (test_invalid_requirement_atomic).
must_include: not even for the items that would have succeeded on their own

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep add requests>=2 Coverage>=7` where `coverage` already exists exits non-zero, mentions `coverage` and `--force`, and pyproject.toml is unchanged — no partial write of the good arg (test_add_multi_requirement_atomic_on_second_conflict).
must_include: the error message has to contain the literal text `--force`

requirements.verifier_assertion: After a successful add, only `pyproject.toml` exists in the project directory — no temp files, no swap files, no backups left behind (test_leftover_temp_file_absent).
must_include: no temp files may be left behind

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep add mkdocs --optional Docs` creates the table `[project.optional-dependencies]` with a lowercased `docs = ["mkdocs"]` entry, and emits ``Added `mkdocs` to field `project.optional-dependencies.docs` `` (test_new_feature_created_with_normalized_name).
must_include: `-o Docs` or `--group Test` — the feature/group key gets written as `docs` / `test`

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep add coverage -o test` on a `[project.optional-dependencies] test = ["pytest"]` writes `test = ["pytest", "coverage"]` — inline appended (test_existing_feature_appended).

`hatch dep add coverage -o docs -o test` where `test` already has `coverage` exits non-zero, mentions `coverage` + `--force`, and `[project.optional-dependencies] docs` is NOT created — atomic across features (test_add_to_multiple_features_atomic_on_conflict).
must_include: the error message has to contain the literal text `--force`

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep add pytest --group Test` on a pyproject with no `[project]` table creates `[dependency-groups]` with lowercased `test = ["pytest"]`, prepended by exactly one blank line, and emits ``Added `pytest` to field `dependency-groups.test` `` (test_new_group_created_without_project_table).
must_include: `-o Docs` or `--group Test` — the feature/group key gets written as `docs` / `test`
newly created table is appended to the end of the file, preceded by one blank line
writing to `dependency-groups` (which lives outside `[project]`) is still allowed

requirements.verifier_assertion: When adding to a group containing `{include-group = "..."}` items, those items are preserved byte-for-byte and the new entry is appended at the end of the array (test_include_group_entries_untouched).
must_include: comments, blank lines, and indentation untouched

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep add ipython --env default` creates `[tool.hatch.envs.default]` with `dependencies = ["ipython"]` when the env didn't exist (test_default_environment_created).
must_include: Only the `default` environment may be auto-created

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep add ruff --env qa` where `qa` is undefined exits non-zero, the error mentions `qa`, and pyproject.toml is unchanged (test_unknown_environment_rejected).
must_include: must be rejected with an error naming the missing environment

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep add debugpy --env lint --extra` appends `debugpy` to `tool.hatch.envs.lint.extra-dependencies`, and emits ``Added `debugpy` to field `tool.hatch.envs.lint.extra-dependencies` `` (test_env_extra_dependencies).

`hatch dep add pytest --env default -o test` exits non-zero, the error mentions both `--env` and `--optional` (or names the conflict), and pyproject.toml is unchanged (test_env_and_optional_are_mutually_exclusive).
`hatch dep add pytest --extra` (with no `--env`) exits non-zero, the error mentions `--extra`, and pyproject.toml is unchanged (test_extra_without_env_rejected).

`hatch dep add requests>=2` on a pyproject declaring `dynamic = ["dependencies"]` exits non-zero, the error contains the word `dynamic`, and pyproject.toml is unchanged (test_dynamic_dependencies_rejected).
must_include: Fields declared via `project.dynamic` must refuse edits
error message has to contain the word `dynamic`

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep add pytest -o test` on a pyproject declaring `dynamic = ["optional-dependencies"]` exits non-zero, the error contains `dynamic`, and pyproject.toml is unchanged (test_dynamic_optional_dependencies_rejected).
must_include: Fields declared via `project.dynamic` must refuse edits

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep add requests>=2` on a pyproject with only `[tool.hatch.envs.default]` (no `[project]` table) exits non-zero, the error mentions `project`, and pyproject.toml is unchanged (test_missing_project_table_rejected).
must_include: the `[project]` table is missing entirely, writing to any `project.*` field is an error

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep add requests>=2 --dry-run` exits 0, prints a unified diff with `--- a/pyproject.toml` and `+++ b/pyproject.toml` headers, contains the `-dependencies = ["click"]` and `+dependencies = ["click", "requests>=2"]` lines, and pyproject.toml is unchanged (test_dry_run_shows_diff_without_writing / add).

`hatch dep remove requests` on a multi-line `project.dependencies` array containing `requests>=2` drops that line while preserving `click>=8` and `httpx` in place, and emits ``Removed `requests` from field `project.dependencies` `` (test_remove_from_project_dependencies).
`hatch dep remove foo-bar-baz` matches an existing entry `Foo.Bar_Baz>=1` and drops it (test_name_matching_normalized).
must_include: independent of extras, version constraints, and markers

requirements.verifier_assertion: Plain `hatch dep remove coverage` (no scoping flag) removes `coverage` from `project.dependencies`, every `project.optional-dependencies.<feature>`, and every `dependency-groups.<group>` — one `Removed ... from field ...` line per hit; environment `tool.hatch.envs.*.dependencies` are left alone (test_default_scope_covers_features_and_groups).
must_include: default scope is all project-level metadata fields
Environment dependencies under `tool.hatch.envs.*` are NOT in the default scope

requirements.verifier_assertion: Plain `hatch dep remove ipython` when `ipython` exists ONLY under `tool.hatch.envs.default.dependencies` exits non-zero, the error mentions `ipython`, and pyproject.toml is unchanged — env-scope is not part of the default remove (test_environments_not_in_default_scope).
must_include: Environment dependencies under `tool.hatch.envs.*` are NOT in the default scope
to remove a dep inside an environment you must pass `--env` explicitly

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep remove requests` where `requests` is absent from all in-scope fields exits non-zero, the error mentions `requests`, and pyproject.toml is unchanged (test_not_found_writes_nothing).
`hatch dep remove requests httpx` when `httpx` is absent exits non-zero, error mentions `httpx`, and `requests` is NOT partially removed — atomic on missing (test_partial_match_aborts_everything).
must_include: if any one item is invalid / conflicts / not-found

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep remove requests>=2` (arg carries a version constraint) exits non-zero, error mentions the offending string or 'Invalid', and pyproject.toml is unchanged (test_requirement_string_rejected_as_name).
must_include: positional arguments to `remove` are bare distribution names
Passing a string with a version constraint

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep remove coverage -o test` removes `coverage` from `project.optional-dependencies.test` only — `project.dependencies` `coverage` entry is left alone (test_scoped_feature_removal).
must_include: With a scoping flag, removal only happens within the corresponding single field

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep remove pytest -o docs` when `[project.optional-dependencies] docs` is undefined exits non-zero, the error mentions `docs`, and pyproject.toml is unchanged (test_undefined_feature_rejected).
must_include: With a scoping flag, removal only happens within the corresponding single field

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep remove ipython --env default` removes `ipython` from `tool.hatch.envs.default.dependencies` (leaving a project-level `ipython` intact) and emits ``Removed `ipython` from field `tool.hatch.envs.default.dependencies` `` (test_environment_scope).

`hatch dep remove requests --dry-run` exits 0, prints unified-diff headers plus the `-dependencies = ["click", "requests>=2"]` and `+dependencies = ["click"]` lines, and pyproject.toml is unchanged (test_dry_run_shows_diff_without_writing / remove).
must_include: Same format for add and remove

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep remove colorama` on a `project.dependencies` array with two `colorama; sys_platform == ...` entries and one unrelated `click` drops both colorama entries in one call, leaving `click` (test_remove_marker_split_duplicates_together).

Dependencies with the same name must all be removed

requirements.verifier_assertion: `hatch dep remove coverage -g dev` on a group containing `{include-group = "lint"}, "mypy", "coverage"` removes only the `coverage` string, leaving the `include-group` directive and other items in place (test_remove_leaves_group_include_directive_alone).

`hatch dep hash -p` output before an add differs from after — `hatch dep hash` must observe the new entry (test_dep_hash_changes_after_add).

`hatch dep show requirements -p` on a pyproject with `dependencies = ["foo", "requests>=2"]` still lists exactly `foo` and `requests>=2` — no regression to the existing `dep show` subcommand (test_existing_dep_show_command_still_works).
